classification.difficultyReason: Translate two sign-and-parity conditions into sets and combine them using union for 'or'.

content.prompt:
Write the following descriptions in set notation, utilising $\cup$ and/or $\cap$ symbols. Some can be listed, whilst others you can try.

Positive even numbers or negative odd numbers.

answer.short: $\{n\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }n>0\text{ and }n\text{ is even}\}\cup\{n\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }n<0\text{ and }n\text{ is odd}\}$
answer.worked:
Use union for “or”, retaining both strict sign restrictions:
$$\{n\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }n>0\text{ and }n\text{ is even}\}\cup\{n\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }n<0\text{ and }n\text{ is odd}\}.$$
